# LoBot LLC website comprehensive guide

## Company Overview
LoBot LLC is an AI-native startup that creates business solutions enabling large enterprises to make future-ready strategic decisions. We specialize in AI-powered software that turns volatile market signals into clear, actionable forecasts.

## Mission Statement
Empower businesses of every size with robust logistics and productivity solutions, accelerate innovation with AI built on open-source foundations, keep open source at our core, and design architectures that scale from startups to large enterprises.

## Products
### TecnoIndicator
Our flagship product: an AI-powered web application that delivers energy price forecasts with interactive visualizations, scenario analysis, and dynamic factor insights.

- Real-time 10-year forecasts for global oil, electricity, and water prices
- Scenario analysis (optimistic, average, pessimistic)
- AI-curated price drivers and strategy recommendations
- Regional intelligence for all continents
- Data export (PNG, CSV, Markdown)
- Open source (MIT license)

## Pages
- Home: / - Hero, problem statement, solution, ecosystem, AI core, CTA
- Products: /products - All products from LoBot
- TecnoIndicator: /products/tecnoindicator - Flagship energy price intelligence tool
- About: /about - Company information, mission, milestones, culture
- Careers: /careers - Job openings, hiring process, company culture
- Blog: /blog - News, stories, and product updates

## Technology Stack
- Framework: Next.js 16 with App Router
- Language: TypeScript
- Styling: Tailwind CSS
- Database: PostgreSQL with Drizzle ORM
- Runtime: Bun
- Deployment: Vercel

## Open Source
All our projects are open source on GitHub: https://github.com/lobot-llc

## Culture
We believe in:
- Trust as the top priority
- Quality over volume
- Technology must benefit everyone
- Accountability
- Fair competition and open source
- Human & AI collaboration

We operate with:
- Flexibility (remote, async)
- Transparency
- Agility (short cycles)
- Optimism
- Positive ownership
